LD_POSITION_TOOLTIP: Click to switch between frame number and timecode.
LD_UNKNOWN_STATE_TYPES: Some of the state this recording carries has nowhere to land: {0}  → that part will not play back.
LDS_DELETE_WHILE_RECORDING: The file being recorded cannot be deleted. Stop the recording first.
LDS_DELETE_CONFIRM_REPLAYING:
Delete {0}?

This is the recording being played. Playback stops before it is deleted.
This cannot be undone.
LDS_BANNER_PLAY_MODE_ONLY: Recording and playback only work in play mode (the gate is pumped from the player loop).
LDS_BANNER_NO_CONTROLLER: No FrameRecorderController in the scene. Add one to a GameObject of the app that records and plays back.
LDS_BANNER_NO_INDEX: This recording has no index (it may not have been closed properly). It plays from the start, but cannot be scrubbed.
LDV_EMPTY_FILTERED: Nothing to show. {0} empty types are hidden by the filter.
LDV_EMPTY_STATE_LANE: The state lane holds nothing. It may be that no type carrying state has been declared yet.
LDV_EMPTY_STRUCTURE_LANE: The structure lane is empty. Nothing has been registered to ride the frame yet.
LDV_HIDE_EMPTY_TOOLTIP: Hides types with no elements, and types that are declared but have no block.
LDV_SHOW_EMPTY_TOOLTIP: {0} empty types are hidden. Click to show them again.
LDV_OBJECT_GONE: This object is no longer in the frame.
LDV_RECIPE_NONE: (none — a replay will not build it again)
LDV_NO_EVENTS: No input has come through yet.
LDV_DETAIL_HINT: Select a row on the left to see what it holds.
LDV_ELEMENT_NOT_IN_FRAME: The selected element is not in this frame.
LDV_EVENT_DROPPED: This input is no longer held.
LDV_PAYLOAD_TRUNCATED: the payload was truncated when it was recorded
LDV_RAW_HINT: add [LiveArray] to show what is inside
